title: Ordinary integer-module presentation and normalized tensor unit for abelian towers
statement: For a scheme T and a tower B of commutative ring sheaves on its pro-etale site, there are a commutative ring sheaf R on the vertical sequence site, a ring map phi from R to the ring of B, and an additive equivalence e from abelian towers to R-module sheaves. The equivalence sends the actual constant integer tower to the rank-one unit R-module. There is a Forget functor with all four literal section and transition equations of [def-sp-tower-class-systems]. For every additive functor E with exactly the ordinary sheafified scalar-extension objects and maps of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], e followed by E is left adjoint to Forget. There is an ordinary multiplication isomorphism E(e(integers)) to the actual coefficient module whose adjunct is exactly integerGenerator. All assertions concern ordinary categories; no derived pair or derived adjunction is asserted.

proof.text: Let O be the constant lifted-integer ring sheaf on the base site and let R be its constant sequence ring. Compose the literal constant-sequence-module equivalence with levelwise forgetting of the unique integer action. The latter is an equivalence by the already proved integerForget_isEquivalence in the residue-quotient-derived-unit module. The composite G is additive and an equivalence; take e to be its inverse.

source.place: clause (2), simultaneous integral reduction; IntegralUnitReduction proof steps 1 and 3, ordinary tensor and integer-unit calculation

proof.text: Each coefficient ring sheaf has a unique map from O, obtained by sheafifying integer cast. Uniqueness makes these maps a natural transformation from the constant O tower to the reconstructed coefficient tower. Uncurrying gives phi:R to B on the sequence site. Restriction along phi followed by G gives Forget: all four section equations follow from the literal realization, and exactness follows from exact restriction and the equivalence G.

source.place: clause (2), simultaneous integral reduction; IntegralUnitReduction proof steps 1 and 3, ordinary tensor and integer-unit calculation

proof.text: Forgetting the constant integer ring to additive groups preserves sheafification: a locally bijective ring-presheaf map has the same equalizer and image sieves after forgetting. Mathlib constantCommuteCompose therefore identifies G(unit R) with the constant integer tower. Transporting its inverse by e and composing with the equivalence counit gives e(integers) isomorphic to unit R. The inverse comparison sends each constant additive integer section to the corresponding ring section.

source.place: clause (2), simultaneous integral reduction; IntegralUnitReduction proof steps 1 and 3, ordinary tensor and integer-unit calculation

proof.text: For any prescribed ordinary scalar-extension functor E, apply the normalized ordinary tensor/restriction adjunction and compose it with the adjunction of e. Compose E of the source-unit comparison with the multiplication comparison E(unit R) to unit B. The composite-adjunction Hom formula and the two equivalence triangles identify its adjunct with the inverse constant-integer comparison followed by forgetting the ordinary multiplication adjunct. On a constant section k, the tensor transpose inserts 1 tensor k, multiplication gives phi(k), and the sheafified integer-cast formula gives k. The proved uniqueness theorem integerGenerator_existsUnique identifies this adjunct with integerGenerator.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_integralTowerScalarPresentation (T : Scheme.{u})
    (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) :
    let J := coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
    let S := SemilinearSections.systemRing.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (fun n ↦ B.obj (op n))
      (fun n ↦ B.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)
    ∃ (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (φ : R ⟶ S)
      (e : Ab T ≌ ringedSiteModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R)),
      e.functor.Additive ∧
      Nonempty (e.functor.obj (integers T) ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit
          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R)) ∧
      ∃ F : Forget T B,
        ∀ (E : ringedSiteModules.{u + 1}
            ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R) ⥤ Systems T B)
          [E.Additive]
          (hobj : ∀ M, E.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u + 1, u + 1} φ M)
          (_hmap : ∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), E.map f =
            eqToHom (hobj M) ≫ SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u + 1, u + 1} φ M f ≫
              eqToHom (hobj N).symm),
          ∃ adj : e.functor ⋙ E ⊣ F.F,
            ∃ b : E.obj (e.functor.obj (integers T)) ≅ coefficient T B,
              adj.homEquiv _ _ b.hom = integerGenerator T B F
